Dear [Mr Bullock](/person/221),
Here is Salisbury. I am sorry I could find no more to say about it, the cathedral having been all built at once, and the Bishops not having been memorable except the last four.[^1] Burnet I could not put in![^2] The sunshine on the Altar on the 15th of August is quite true. I have seen it twice

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY refers to the work she was doing for Bullock\'s Daily Lections project. The last four Bishops of Salisbury had been [Edward Denison](/person/2137), [Walter Kerr Hamilton](/person/2138), [George Moberly](/person/1015) and [John Wordsworth](/person/1567), all High Churchmen.
[^2]: Gilbert Burnet (1643-1715) was probably both too worldly and too Low Church to please CMY.
